desc.en: Ziyarat of Ummul Baneen (s), Mother of Hazrat Abbas (a). The name of Ummul Baneen is Fatema, the daughter of Hezaam. She was an extremely righteous, valiant, religious, accomplished and sincere lady. After the martyrdom of Hazrat Fatema Zahra (s), she became the wife of Hazrat Ali (a). She gave birth to 4 sons Abbas, Abdullah, Jafar and Usmaan. All of them fought on the side of Imam Husain (a) and achieved martyrdom. Ummul Baneen used to mourn on her 4 sons and other martyrs of Karbala. She also composed Marsiyas (Poems of sorrow) in their honour and thus she was the one who has kept the memory of Karbala alive. Recite the Ziyarat of Ummul Baneen (s) as follows…
desc.rurdu: Ummul Baneen (s) ki ziyarat jo Hazrat Abbas (a) ki waaleda hai. Dar haqeeqat Ummul Baneen ka naam Fatema binte Hezaam hai. Woh ek behtareen muttaqi aur parhez-gaar bibi thi. Hazrat Fatima Zahra (s) ki shahadat ke baad, Ummul Baneen, Hazrat Ali (a) ki biwi bani. Unse 4 awlaad huwi, Abbas, Abdullah, Jafar aur Usmaan. Inki sabhi aulaado’n ne Imam Husain (a) ki nusrat karte huwe Karbala mein shaheed huwe. Unho ne Karbala par marsiya bhi likkha aur is tarah unho ne Karbala ki yaad ko zindah rakkha. Ummul Baneen (s) ki ziyarat is tarah se hai…

trans.en: In the Name of Allah, the most Gracious, the most Merciful.
trans.rurdu: (Shuru karta hu) Allah ke naam se Jo bada maher-baan nehaayat rahem karne waala hai.
trans.urdu: اللہ کے نام سے (شروع کرتا ہوں) جو بڑا مہربا ن نہایت رحم کرنے والا ہے۔

arabic.text: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكِ یَا زَوْجَۃَ وَلِیِّ اللہِ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكِ یَا زَوْجَۃَ اَمِیْرِ الْمُؤْمِنِیْنَ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكِ یَا اُمَّ الْبَنِیْنَ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكِ یَا اُمَّ الْعَبَّاسِ ابْنِ اَمِیْرِ الْمُؤْمِنِیْنَ عَلِیِّ بْنِ اَبِیْ طَالِبٍ رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْكِ وَجَعَلَ الْجَنَّۃَ مَنْزِلَكِ وَمَاْوٰیكِ وَرَحْمَۃُ اللہِ وَبَرَكَاتُہٗ۔

lines.rarabic: ASSALAAMO A’LAYKE YAA ZAWJATA WALIYYIL LAAHE ASSALAAMO A’LAYKE YAA ZAWJATA AMEERIL MOA-MENEENA ASSALAAMO A’LAYKE YAA UMMAL BANEENA ASSALAAMO A’LAYKE YAA UMMAL A’BBAASIBNE AMEERIL MOA-MENEENA A’LIYYIBNE ABEE TAALEBIN RAZEYAL LAAHO TA-A’ALAA A’NKE WA JA-A’LAL JANNATA MANZELAKE WA MAAWAAKE WA RAHMATUL LAAHE WA BARAKAATOHU.

trans.en: Peace be on you, the wife of the beloved one of Allah, Peace be on you, the wife of the Commander of the Faithful, Peace be on you, O Ummul Baneen Peace be on you, the mother of Abbas, son of Amir al-Momeneen, Ali ibn Abu Talib, May Allah be pleased with you and make Jannat your home and resting place, with God’s mercy and blessings.
trans.rurdu: Salaam ho aap par ay zawja'e Waliye Khuda. Salaam ho aap par ay zawja'e Ameerul Momeneen (a.s). Salaam ho aap par ay Ummul Baneen. Salaam ho aap par ay maadar'e giraami Abbas ibne Ameerul Momeneen Ali ibne Abu Talib (a.s). Khuda aap se raazi ho aur Jannat aap ki manzil aur maqaam qaraar de aur Allah ki rehmat aur barkaat ho aap par.
trans.urdu: سلام ہو آپ پر اے زوجۂ ولیِ خدا، سلام ہو آپ پر اے زوجۂ امیر المومنینؑ، سلام ہو آپ پر اے ام البنین، سلام ہو آپ پر اے مادر گرامی عباس ابن امیر المومنین علی ابن ابی طالبؑ، خدا آپ سے راضی ہو اور جنت آپ کی منزل اور مقام قرار دے اور اللہ کی رحمت اور برکات ہوں آپ پر۔

arabic.text: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ۔

lines.rarabic: ALLAHUMMA SWALLE ALAA MUHAMMADIW WA AALE MUHAMMADIN

trans.en: Allah’s (s.w.t) choicest blessings be upon Mohammed and his holy progeny.
trans.rurdu: Parwardigaar Tu rehmat naazil farma Hazrat Muhammad (s.a.w.a) aur unki Aal (a.s) par.
trans.urdu: اے معبود! رحمت نازل فرما حضرت محمدؐ اور انکی آل ؑپر۔
